2115156595797864560.en_summary: $TSLA Tesla CFO: Automotive gross margins excluding credits improved from 16.3% to 18.1%, supported by a higher APAC delivery mix. Improvement driven by higher APAC mix. Commodity price increases and interest rate changes add to costs and headwinds, but vehicle financing programs adjusted to partially offset.
2115156595797864560.zh_summary: TSLA特斯拉CFO：剔除信用額的汽車毛利率從16.3%提升至18.1%，得益於亞太交付組合提高。改善由亞太組合提高驅動。商品價格上漲與利率變動增加成本並帶來逆風，但已調整車輛融資計劃部分抵銷這些成本。

2115154721866695051.en_summary: The FCC just approved $AMZN acquisition of Globalstar which could bring Amazon Leo into satellite-to-phone market while giving it access to Globalstar's existing relationship with $AAPL. And with $SPCX buying EchoStar spectrum and $ASTS securing its own rights the race is really about controlling the frequencies needed to connect directly to phones.
2115154721866695051.zh_summary: FCC剛剛批准AMZN收購Globalstar，這可能讓Amazon Leo進入衛星到手機市場，同時獲得Globalstar與AAPL的現有關係。加上SPCX購買EchoStar頻譜以及ASTS確保自己的權利，這場競賽實際上是關於控制直接連接手機所需的頻率。
